zh_summary: @SawyerMerritt 描述較大的 400 升碳纖維纏繞壓力容器 (COPV) 將置於 @Tesla Roadster 火箭版本的乘客座位，使此版本成為單座。與後部 200 升水箱結合，僅限於推力與火箭版本，火箭版本總容量 600 升。火箭版本共有 10 個推進器：四個後向、四個下向、兩個側向。詳述三個版本：性能版本有四個後風扇、吸力系統及裙邊；推力版本加上四個後向加速推進器與 200 升 COPV；火箭版本加上四個下向及兩個側向推進器與 400 升 COPV。
text:
This is the larger 400-liter carbon overwrapped pressure vessel (COPV) that will go in the passenger seat in the rocket trim of @Tesla's Roadster, which is why this version is a one-seater. Combined with a 200L tank in the rear, available only on the Thrust and Rocket trims, the Rocket trim will have a total capacity of 600L.

Rocket trim comes with 10 total thrusters around the vehicle: Four rear-facing, four downward-facing, and two side-facing.

• Performance trim: Four rear fans, suction system and front and rear deployable skirts.
• Thrust trim: Four rear fans, suction system, front and rear deployable skirts & four rear-facing acceleration thrusters (with 200L COPV tank).
• Rocket trim: Four rear fans, suction system, front and rear deployable skirts, four rear-facing acceleration thrusters (with 200L COPV tank), four-downward facing & two side facing thrusters (with 400L COPV tank).
